text_name.description: The full name of the text in its original script, e.g., 'तैत्तिरीयोपनिषत्'.

structure_levels.description: An ordered list of names for the structural levels, from largest to smallest, e.g., ['Valli', 'Anuvaka', 'Mantra']. The application uses this to parse the hierarchy.

content.description: An array of the top-level structural nodes (e.g., an array of Valli objects).

type.description: The type of this node, matching a name from structure_levels, e.g., 'Valli', 'Anuvaka', 'Mantra'.

name.description: The name of this node, e.g., 'Anandavalli'. Optional for structural nodes.

number.description: The sequential number of this node within its parent, used for URL generation.

children.description: An array of child nodes (for structural nodes). Omit this field for leaf nodes.

file.description: The relative path to a JSON file containing the children for this node (for lazy-loaded structural nodes). Mutually exclusive with 'children'.

text.description: The main content of the leaf node (for leaf nodes only).

commentary_text.description: The associated commentary text (for leaf nodes). Markdown is supported.
